title: Card 3207 SCSI/floppy controller, plug A: floppy drive lines

usedBy.note: the drawing this file was read from

sources.document: ND-350007-A1-EN Schematic Circuit Diagrams (card 3207 SCSI/floppy controller, print 3207 A1, 24 sheets, drawn 90.07.09); scan kept outside this repository
sources.note: Read from the page images at 500-600 dpi. Labels copied exactly as printed; a tilde marks active low.
Appendix F-2 plug C table: used to prove what the drawing's supply symbols are (open triangle = GND).

pinNumbering.value: rows a, b, c x pins 1-32; the drawing prints a pin as 'A A12' = plug A, row a, pin 12

note: Plug A is card specific: the backplane wires it per slot, unlike plug C. Sheet 1 is titled 'EXTERNAL CONNECTIONS' and draws every plug A pin; all its signal names are floppy drive lines, which confirms pcb.json's 'A = floppy bus'. Port shapes on sheet 1: arrow into the card's block on the left (F5INDEX~, FTROO~, FWPRT~, XRD~, F5READY~, FTWOS~, FDISKCH~, CKDIS~, TFRQ), arrow out on the right (8HLD5OPT~, DS~00-02, 8DS35MOT~, DIR~, STEP~, WDAT~, WG~, F5SSEL~, CURRSW~, F8SSEL~, INUSE~), six-sided (both ways) for 8REA5DS3~ and 8IND5INU~. What each signal means is not stated on the drawing and is not recorded here. Glyphs settled by shape: zero has an inner stroke, letter O has none; 5 has a flat top, S a curved top; 8 is closed.

unusedPins.note: no plug A pin with these numbers is drawn on any of sheets 1-3

disagreements.value: Plug A on 3207 draws rows a and b with signals and all 25 row c pins as GND. ND-06.016.01 section I.2.3 (1980) says plugs A and B have 64 lines each (recorded in nd100-c-connector). The drawing is taken as the truth for this card (owner ruling 2026-11-27). Whether the 1980 figure is wrong, or later backplanes wire more of plugs A and B, is open: ND-06.017.01 'ND-100 Backplane/Bus Description' (1979) would settle it but no copy has been found.
